messages.text: BL-1838 🎵 in progress — A local-model seat's qwen gives up at the contextWindowSize in the operator's ~/.qwen/settings.json, written once by a launcher that never updates an existing entry - on 2026-09-30 coder@iq3's model was re-served at num_ctx 49152 while that entry still said 32768, and the seat died at 'hard limit: 30852.8' with 16k tokens of window unused; the swarm writes the seat's model entry into the worktree's own .qwen/settings.json with the window its model is served with
